properties.statement: Giving a successful template expansion more fuel preserves its output, including when other references occur in its bindings.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (lib : List (String × Esm.Expr.Template)) (fuel larger : Nat), fuel ≤ larger → ∀ (term result : Esm.Expr.Ast), Esm.Expr.expandRefs lib fuel term = .ok result → Esm.Expr.expandRefs lib larger term = .ok result

properties.statement: Two successful expansions of the same input have identical AST results at any fuel bounds when their registries bind each definition name identically.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (left right : List (String × Esm.Expr.Template)), (∀ name, left.lookup name = right.lookup name) → ∀ (leftFuel rightFuel : Nat) (term leftResult rightResult : Esm.Expr.Ast), Esm.Expr.expandRefs left leftFuel term = .ok leftResult → Esm.Expr.expandRefs right rightFuel term = .ok rightResult → leftResult = rightResult

properties.statement: Binding an outer template's parameter to a number preserves the same-spelled free name of a distinct nested template with no parameters.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (outer inner parameter : String), outer ≠ inner → ∀ (coefficient : Int) (exponent : Nat), Esm.Expr.expandRefs [(outer, ⟨[parameter], .apply inner .nil⟩), (inner, ⟨[], .var parameter⟩)] 2 (.apply outer (.cons parameter (.num coefficient exponent) .nil)) = .ok (.var parameter)
